extensions.intro: A separately registered experiment compares dedicated and fractional GPU placement for the same hourly jobs. Carbon estimates cover modeled GPU electricity only.
extensions.limit: Sharing assumes no interference or quality loss and capacity that can shrink each hour. GPU nameplate power and PUE are assumptions. The regional grid factor is a proxy; the total footprint is unknown. No production savings are claimed.

statement: mlspend is a portfolio demonstration. Its platform costs are simulated with known truth. Its portfolio costs are shadow estimates of public project usage at published list prices; nobody paid these amounts. No figure is a quote, an invoice or financial advice.
